name: supporter-grid
title: Supporter Grid
description: A thank-you lockup for backers: a heart draws itself, pulses and docks upward while supporter avatars blur-stagger into a grid, then a headline, a supporter count and a call-to-action pill arrive.
useWhen: A thank-you beat for funders or backers: the heart draws itself, docks upward, and every supporter avatar staggers into a grid.
A funding ask needs to end on a call-to-action pill and a link line.
The grid and the "Powered by N supporters" line should size themselves to a supporter list.
avoidWhen: The milestone is a count that climbs (stars, followers): use star-counter or followers-overview.
The subject is one person's profile instead of a group of supporters: use profile-follow-card.
You need a neutral partner or integration lineup without the heart and CTA: use logo-enter.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Supporters
variables.description: Comma-separated names; each becomes an initial avatar and the count feeds the "Powered by" line.
variables.default: Ada, Ben, Chloe, Dev, Eli, Fay, Gus, Hana, Ivo, June, Kai, Lena, Milo, Nia, Omar, Pia, Quin, Rhea, Sol, Tess, Uma, Vik, Wren, Zoe

variables.label: Heading
variables.description: Headline that blurs in under the grid.

variables.label: Subline
variables.description: Line under the heading; {count} becomes the number of supporters.

variables.label: Link line
variables.description: Small muted line under the button. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the heart and the button.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the lockup sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
